cases.name: sets with one overlapping pair overlap
cases.why: Two sets overlap if any pattern of one overlaps any pattern of the other.

cases.name: sets with no overlapping pair do not overlap
cases.why: Every pair must be disjoint for the sets to be disjoint.

cases.name: an empty set overlaps nothing
cases.why: A claim with no paths conflicts with no claim.

cases.name: two empty sets do not overlap
cases.why: There is no pair to compare.

informational.error: Invalid regular expression: /^[z-a]$/: Range out of order in character class

cases.name: a pattern that throws makes the lists throw
cases.why: The reference compares the pairs in order, and the second pair throws. The seventh open question of the README gives the rule.

cases.name: a pair that overlaps before the pattern that throws makes the lists overlap
cases.why: The reference stops at the first pair that overlaps, so it never reads the pattern that throws.

description: Whether the path lists of two claims overlap.
